card.name: Last word before a dash separator
card.fires_on: The final word of a drug, condition or list item just before a spaced dash or minus sign (−) that introduces a comment. It is seen in label tables that pair an item with a note.

modes.label: Condition list items
modes.description: The end of a condition or term in a list of contraindications, right before a dash and the next item.
modes.example: Central nervous system hemorrh<<age>> − Cerebral aneurysms

modes.label: Drug name before a note
modes.description: The end of a drug or drug class name in an interaction table, right before a dash and its effect.
modes.example: Ion Exchange res<<ins>> − Single doses of either cholesty

modes.label: Phrase before a dash
modes.description: The last word of a clause before a dash that continues the statement.
modes.example: known to cause hypotension or syn<<cope>> − can cause hypotension and syn

card.writes: It predicts a dash-like separator or line break next and suppresses the minus-sign characters, so it likely favors other punctuation.
card.plain: It fires on the last word of an entry just before a dash that leads into a note, as in label tables.
